notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). SIMDTESTToken takes no constructor arguments and mints all 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units to msg.sender. There is no subsequent minting, ownership or administration; all launch parameters are constants. Transfers and transferFrom sourced from the fixed Uniswap v4 PoolManager, 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, burn floor(amount / 100) minor units, reducing totalSupply and delivering the remainder. Sells, pool seeding and wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed. Distribution and pool seeding occur outside the token. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance sqrtPriceX96 for SIMDTEST as currency0; the deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, token.totalSupply and deployed currency order.
